description: Hunebed D49, the Papeloze Kerk, sits in the woods between Schoonoord and Noord-Sleen. One half is covered by a restored turf mound and the other half shows the capstones. A ring of kerb stones circles the foot. It is partly cloudy, about 8.6°C, with wind near 5.0 km/h and cloud cover about 78%. Borger and Havelte are other tombs and are not this one.
